description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 17 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture. 

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as ING, Millenium Bank, Play, Wavin, Arabian Drilling, FedEX, Leroy Merlin, Edenred, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing

 

We are looking for an experienced .NET Developer to join our team and work on projects within the travel industry.

You will have an opportunity to contribute to various projects and collaborate with different teams responsible for developing, maintaining, and integrating systems. The focus will be on building reliable, scalable, and high-performance backend solutions supporting business-critical processes, including booking and search functionalities.

You will be:

  • designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and applications using .NET and Azure,

  • building and integrating cloud-based solutions to support various business processes,

  • contributing to the development of scalable and high-performance systems, particularly booking and search functionalities,

  • designing and implementing integrations between different systems and services,

  • ensuring code quality, reliability, and maintainability through testing and code reviews,

  • identifying performance bottlenecks and implementing optimization strategies,

  • monitoring system performance and reliability using appropriate observability tools,

  • collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment,

  • applying security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

Your profile:

  • developing backend applications using .NET (C#), preferably .NET 6 or later,

  • working with Azure Cloud Services, including Azure Functions, App Services, Azure Storage, and Azure Service Bus,

  • using Azure monitoring tools, such as Application Insights,

  • working with SQL and NoSQL databases, such as Azure SQL and Cosmos DB,

  • applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles, including domain boundaries, ownership, and modular architecture,

  • writing unit and integration tests using frameworks and tools such as xUnit, NUnit, and Moq,

  • optimizing backend performance through profiling, load testing, and performance tuning,

  • implementing observability practices, including logging, tracing, and alerting,

  • ensuring the reliability and scalability of backend services,

  • practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery.

  • Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

  • experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work.

  • interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. agent-based workflows, automation patterns, AI-augmented development), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.

 

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
